protocol.validationScope: Fresh SQLite file per cell, synchronous direct service validate inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE; no HTTP/browser time, contention, other writers or external effects. The measured wrapper includes transaction begin/end. Original approvals are not re-reviewed between validation samples; field ABA remains invalid.
protocol.captureScope: One initial immutable full snapshot + sealed preview, and explicit all-clause review measured separately per cell. This includes common contract generation required by all modes.
protocol.commitScope: After validation samples, one fresh sealed snapshot and explicit all-clause review precede one real simulated commit per cell; complete authority/intent/rule/evidence checks and SQLite receipt/effect/outcome write are included. These are descriptive single observations per pattern, not latency distribution estimates.
protocol.safety: All retained decisions checked against the independent full oracle before recording a sample; any unsafe retention aborts timing. This is correctness checking, not an independent functional scenario count.
protocol.report: Preserve dense/shared-budget cases and negative speedups. Quantiles describe only these local samples. Review counts/fields are workload proxies, not measured human time. Serialized byte sizes are not process heap memory. No asymptotic, deployment or user-benefit claim is inferred.
